newsitem.title: FRANCE: French wheat steady ahead of EU grain auction.
newsitem.headline: French wheat steady ahead of EU grain auction.

text.p: French wheat prices were steady on Thursday as operators awaited the outcome of the weekly European Union grain auction, dealers said.
Rouen wheat for February delivery was unchanged from Wednesday at 855 francs per tonne.
Rouen wheat gained five francs on Wednesday, as one large trade house turned buyer amid thin offers.
In France exporters bid to ship 483,000 tonnes of European Union soft wheat at rebates ranging from 13.95 to 18.57 Ecus per tonne.
Several exporters were hoping the European Union would grant a subsidy of 15 Ecus per tonne allowing the export of up to 250,000 tonnes of wheat.
Exporters had been expected to bid for a substantial wheat volume this week after the European Union reduced exports last week.
"They must make up for ground lost last week," one dealer said.
French cash grain prices exclude carrying charges of 3.64 francs per tonne, which must be added to every half month between August 1 last year and the delivery period in question.
